why: Issue #713. The positional rule ignores `skipPads`, so a campaign or co-op gamepad slot is bound to the pad at its own index even when that pad is connected and unreadable. The player in that slot gets a tank that never moves, and nothing says why until they open Pause.
killedBy: deriveInitialAssignment skips a pad Tanks cannot read, and every later gamepad slot moves past it (issue #713)
